g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-301 Ribbon blender 6 cu ft (built in house) · rev B
Product contact #4, Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967 inside; outside #4 / bead blast
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
1-1/2 in TC FERRULE (item 7), level switch P1-337
hole Ø38.6 [1.520] in the front wall
4 in TC FERRULE (item 6) on Ø98.3 [3.870] hole
R298 [11.732] END PLATE (15 [.59] proud of the shell)

svg.text: DETAIL C SHELL TO END PLATE, TYPICAL ALL ROUND 2:1
Shell end ring, free end (sheet P1-301-108)
Hinge knuckle Ø20 x 38, bore Ø10.2
WELD SCHEDULE (GTAW, ER316L, argon; AWS D1.6)
inside ground flush to the wall
fillet 6 all round outside; inside fillet 3
outside only; seat flat after weld 0.5
jig: both pins on one axis 0.3
1. FREE END IS BOLTED: the ring (item 9) is welded to the shell; the free-end plate P1-301-110 with its stuffing box (phantom here) bolts on with
gasket P1-301-111 and 15 x H13. The agitator slides in from the free end (P1-301-003 step 4).
2. Weld sequence: (1) bolt the free-end plate to the ring with the gasket, tack the shell into the drive end plate and the ring on a flat table with
the alignment bar Ø63.8 x 1100 through both stuffing-box throats; (2) tack the boxes, check bar turns free; (3) weld W1 and W3 in short balanced runs,
inside first; (4) fit flange, check flat 1.5 [.06], weld W2; (5) lugs and ferrules last.
3. Box faces must be parallel and square to the bar within 0.2 [.008] and concentric to it within 0.25 [.010] after welding. If not, face and bore the
boxes in place on a boring bar before passivating.
4. Flange top flat within 1.5 [.06] over the full frame; no weld spatter on the gasket land.
5. All inside welds ground flush, blended, no pits, cracks or crevices. Inside surface #4, Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]. Passivate the finished weldment to
6. Lug seats bear on the frame rails: grind the four seats coplanar within 1 [.04] with the trough on its flange (upside down) on the table.
7. Inspect per P1-301-900 items T1..T6 before passivation. Mark part no. and heat no. on the outside of an end plate (vibro-etch).
